title: Chroma
description: A Collection of code commonly used in Nitron's heavily rendering focused mods.
body:
Adds a whole bunch of useful rendering utilities for your mods!

![Supernova](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed5a790e94d24391051859fcbb5ffbfbaf47ce3f_0.webp)

Features include:
- Chroma particles: Additive particles that are super simple to make.
- Screenshake: Shakes your camera with a Vec3 for its source.
- [Experimental] Lens Flare: Attack lens flares to certain positions in your world
- [Experimental] Post Effects: Easily add or remove post effects at runtime.

Planned:
- More Shader support, such as core shaders and RenderLayer helpers.
- GUI Utilities, such as custom draw calls.
